attempts.journal_recovery: After QEMU stopped, extracted the root partition into a separate file and replayed its ext4 journal with e2fsck. The retained guest.raw was not repaired or modified. The recovered system journal ends at the first persistent flush around guest time 180.94 seconds; the console retains the later failure.
attempts.observation: Kernel enumerated vda1 and vda15 and mounted root read/write. Systemd started waiting for the EFI PARTUUID at guest time 137.566 seconds. The console shows static-device setup still starting near the device timeout, followed by failed boot-efi.mount and emergency mode. No SSH attempt occurred.
attempts.hypothesis: Startup prerequisites delay udev beyond the device deadline; not yet established by a passing controlled experiment

attempts.observation: Adding systemd.default_device_timeout_sec=600 changed the generated DTB. Decompiled old and new DTBs differ only in that bootargs addition; the old pinned checksum correctly rejected the modified artifact.
attempts.lifecycle: Gate exited 2; QEMU was never launched

attempts.revision: a44c704 runtime with 600-second device timeout and updated DTB pin; 7a7b6f9 adds evidence only
attempts.observation: Udev started, EFI partition was discovered, checked and mounted, and local-fs.target was reached. Stock cloud-init configured networking and Debian reached login. First SSH attempt timed out; second passed using the console-pinned Ed25519 host key, returned exact aarch64 newline and completed sudo -n sync.

Fresh QEMU process reused the original managed disk after verifying the staged source identity. EFI mounted and login was reached. SSH attempt one timed out during banner exchange; attempt two reported server not responding; attempt three authenticated with the original host-key receipt, returned exact aarch64 newline and completed sudo -n sync. First-boot and cold-boot known_hosts receipts are byte-identical.
attempts.diagnostics: Journald reported its prior system journal corrupted or uncleanly shut down, renamed it and continued. The preceding gate synced the disk and stopped QEMU; it did not perform a guest shutdown.

limits: Fresh-disk and same-disk cold-boot login and key-only SSH with retained host identity are established for this profile on Spark. Authenticated timing receipts, timing parity, graphics integration and release readiness remain unproven.
